report_text: Creative Fatigue Report — Over the last 60 days, 205 ads were analyzed. The account shows a balanced fatigue posture with 122 ads to KEEP, 82 on WATCH for early signs of fatigue, 1 ad recommended for REFRESH, and no ads flagged for ROTATE or ACT NOW. This indicates most creatives are performing steadily, but some require attention to maintain efficiency. Top 3 to replace first: 1) Ad_038/4/1_BOF(Purchasers_180D)_Catalog(All_Products) is flagged for REFRESH due to significant declines in sales KPIs. ROAS dropped 26.3%, CPA increased 34.1%, and purchase conversion rate fell 6.4%, alongside a steep 78% drop in reach and link clicks, signaling audience saturation and performance trend decline after 542 days in market. These trends reduce ad efficiency and increase costs, warranting a creative refresh within 14 days. 2) No additional ads currently meet the REFRESH or ROTATE threshold, but 82 ads on WATCH show early fatigue signals such as minor ROAS and CPA shifts or audience saturation. These should be monitored closely to prevent further decline. Overall, the account is stable but proactive creative updates on flagged ads will help sustain sales performance and cost efficiency.
